result: If I could change the world in one fundamental way, I would cultivate widespread empathy and compassion. When we’re able to look beyond ourselves and genuinely consider others’ contexts and struggles, it becomes easier to act in ways that reduce harm, promote fairness, and build supportive communities. In practical terms, this might mean prioritizing equitable education, championing restorative justice, and encouraging inclusive dialogue—each fostered by a sense of shared humanity. Empathy alone won’t solve every issue, but it provides a powerful lens through which we can work together to address inequality, protect the environment, and ultimately meet one another’s needs so everyone can thrive.
